complete.noteHint: Where the photos or documents are, readings taken, anything the next person should know.

material.managerIntro: Material is still with the contractor. Record what was used or returned on the Material tab, or hand over now and say why.
material.staffIntro: Material is still with the contractor. Record what was used or returned on the Material tab, or ask a manager to hand over.
material.reasonHint: Kept in the project history and the audit trail.

waiting.title: Mark as waiting
waiting.partyHint: Time waiting on the customer, bank or DISCOM is reported apart from the team's own time. Choosing “Our team” asks for help: the project manager hears straight away.
waiting.noteHint: For example: inspection requested at MSEDCL Sangli on 2 November.

reschedule.title: Change due date
reschedule.reasonHint: Kept in the project history. For example: customer away until Monday.
reschedule.chainNote: Tasks that wait on this one move later too, only as far as they need to.
reschedule.surveyNote: The customer is told the date on WhatsApp, or by SMS if they are not on WhatsApp. Tasks that wait on the survey move later too.

update.title: Post update
update.body: A short note on progress for the project history. The task stays as it is.
update.label: Update
update.hint: For example: structure fixed on the east side, panels go up tomorrow.

sendBack.title: Send back for correction
sendBack.body: The task goes back to the person who did it, with your note on what to fix. It counts as rework.
sendBack.label: What needs correcting
sendBack.hint: Be specific. For example: earthing photo is blurred, take it again.

assign.title: Assign task
assign.everyone: Show everyone, not only this task's role
assign.nobody: Nobody active holds this task's role. Show everyone to pick someone else.

money.title: Received
money.referenceHint: UTR, cheque number or receipt number.

money.tdsSettles: Together they settle {amount} of the milestone.

collected.collectedByHint: Who holds the money until it is deposited in the bank.

explain.revised: The survey changed the price beyond the tolerance band. The customer accepted the revised quotation, and the budget is locked on it.
